verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official MCP server and an agent-skills plugin that let external AI clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI) query and act on Remote data. That is an adjacent capability. Nothing in the pack documents a built-in AI assistant inside the Remote product that users can delegate tasks to, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
